summary: One static thank-you and update page for the creators who are already onboarded to the Riffi Creator Program. A creator who got a personal Instagram DM from Zyra reads the launch estimate, sees the Founding Creator badge and the perks waiting for them, and sends their details in an on-page form that posts to the founder's Google Form. No backend or logins; mobile-first for Instagram's in-app browser, and honest about every promise.

buyNotBuilt.service: no login system at all (this page has none by design - PRD section 0)
no payment handling at all (points, vouchers and payouts live in the Riffi app, not this page)
no secrets at all (anything in a VITE_ variable is public; deploy settings live in Vercel)
Vercel static hosting (Cloudflare Pages is the PRD equal alternative)
the page's own details form posting to a Google Form the founder owns (Instagram ig.me and WhatsApp wa.me links remain as unused settings)
Fontsource self-hosted variable fonts (Archivo, Hanken Grotesk)
Lucide React, six icons at most, tree-shaken
off by default; only cookieless Plausible or Umami if switched on

product.audience: Instagram creators who make opinionated video content (under 20k followers, largely college students) and who have already said yes to joining Riffi. Zyra sends each of them the link in a personal Instagram DM, so they arrive warm, never as cold traffic, overwhelmingly on mid-range Android phones on 4G inside Instagram's in-app browser. They have been pitched by plenty of growth-hack programs before and compare notes with each other.
jobs: Feel thanked, and understand honestly why the launch is later than they expected and when to expect it (an estimate, never a promise).
See what is waiting for them: the Founding Creator badge, and the perks (three at launch, two "soon" - the later ones a plan, not a contract).
Send the five details Riffi needs to hold their username and set them up, in about a minute, and know it worked.
Know honestly what is and is not paid, and that they own what they post.
product.success: A creator opens the link, feels thanked and informed, sends their details in a minute and sees a clear thank-you - and nothing the page said turns out untrue when they compare notes. On the phone they actually use, the page is fast inside Instagram, never breaks at any width from 320px up, and still reads correctly without colour or motion.
keyFlows: Zyra DMs a creator the link -> Instagram shows the preview card (the thank-you headline) -> the creator taps it.
The page opens -> hero (thank-you and the estimate), the badge, the perks, the details form, a three-question FAQ, the close.

The creator taps "Send your details" (hero or close) -> the page scrolls to the form -> they fill five fields and send -> the panel becomes a thank-you, the badge swishes in, and "We're holding @name for you" is read back.
Zyra rewrites copy or changes a setting by editing one content file; the brand-kit swap is one tokens file plus one wordmark SVG.
nonGoals: No backend, database, login, CMS or third-party embed. The one conversion is the page's own details form, which posts to the founder's Google Form (`src/lib/submit.ts`) - and nothing else: no tracker, no cookie, no second form.
No forecasting, predictions, accuracy percentages, prediction UI, app screenshots or device mockups.
No fabricated scarcity or proof: no countdown timer, no seat count, no fake testimonials, logos or user counts; the one sample take on the page is always labelled as a sample.
No published reward point values, no payout figures and no guaranteed-earnings language - future monetisation is always "a plan, not a contract".
No Next.js, no animation library, UI kit, form library or state manager, and no dark mode; analytics stays off unless switched on, and then only cookieless Plausible or Umami.
product.scale: Traffic is only the creators Zyra DMs personally - tens to a few hundred visits - served as static files from a CDN, so there is no server, no database and nothing that grows without limit. The binding constraint is weight, not scale: fast on a mid-range Android on 4G inside Instagram (JS under 90KB gzipped, whole page under 400KB, LCP about 2s, CLS under 0.02, Lighthouse mobile Performance 95+ and Accessibility 100). maturityTier = prelaunch until the first creator is sent the link.
